description: Operator (or a prior agent) builds a capacity -- working demo, code, contract, tool, deliverable. Time passes. A new agent session wakes. The agent has no memory of the capacity; its rehydration reads only recent chain rows, so older durable state is invisible. The agent then reasons and recommends AS IF the capacity never existed -- typically proposing to build or buy what already exists. The operator must re-prove the capacity, which wastes operator attention and erodes trust in every synthesis the swarm produces.
mechanism: Chain-row-based memory has temporal bias: recent activity is visible, older durable state requires explicit lookup. Agents optimize for citing-what-they-read rather than inventorying the filesystem before reasoning. Compounds with L_DESCRIPTOR_GREEN_IS_NOT_RUNTIME_GREEN in both directions: an agent may claim a capacity works because a chain row says so, or claim it does not exist because no recent chain row mentions it.
reconciles_with: L_UNINDEXED_CAPABILITY (proposed 2026-07-31 in this same session, from the agent side). CAPACITY_AMNESIA is the superset and the canonical name: the operator named the phenomenon from the operator's side (losing a capacity to the swarm's forgetting), and it subsumes the agent-side observation. L_UNINDEXED_CAPABILITY is retained as an alias, not a separate class.

SELF-DEMONSTRATING, same session, ~10 minutes after authoring specimen 4: Sigrun reported chain-writes as BLOCKED and staged rows to inbox after append_chain_note.py refused, without knowing work/scripts/bb_append.py is documented as 'the ONE blessed lock-safe chain appender' and is named explicitly in scripts/no_direct_lane_returns_writes.py as the allowed write path. The agent that had just measured the failure class committed it inside the same turn. This is the strongest available evidence that the class is structural, not an attention lapse.

cure: contracts/schemas/capacity_manifest.v0_1.json -- a machine-readable inventory of every HFO capability with a runnable acceptance test. contracts/rehydration_golden_path.v0_1.md wake step 1 MUST include reading state/ssot/capacity_manifest.jsonl. Any recommendation to build, buy, or acquire that does not cite a manifest read is a CAPACITY_AMNESIA violation.
symmetric_risk: The mirror failure is equally destructive: an agent trusting a manifest row for a capacity that silently rotted. The schema therefore carries decay_days (default 30) after which verified_status auto-degrades to 'drifted'. A verified capacity is a perishable claim.
falsifier: If sessions still reason as if a capacity is absent AFTER the manifest exists and is required-read on wake, the manifest is decoration and not a gate. Concrete test: seed the manifest with one capability, start a fresh session, ask it to solve a problem that capability addresses, and observe whether it cites the manifest row or proposes to build the thing again.
honest_flaw: The cure is a document plus a protocol amendment. Neither is enforced by a hook today. On this session's own evidence -- specimen 5 -- an unenforced protocol does not survive contact with a timebox. Until a wake hook fails closed on a missing manifest read, this registration predicts the cure will work rather than demonstrating it.
